purpose: A fixed, non-formal regression subset for Writer v1 plus Director optimization.
selection_rule: Choose tasks where the Writer+Director full run is weaker than Original and tool calls are non-increasing, while retaining distinct failure modes that are actionable in the Writer/Director/Actor execution path.

tasks.failure_mode: Long nine-step Lark chain is truncated after the initial reads; required chat, calendar and notification writes disappear.
tasks.optimization_target: Preserve a dependency-aware complete plan and make the handoff distinguish required milestones from optional verification.

tasks.failure_mode: The two required Notion mutations are reduced to a delete plus append calls; the required update operation is omitted.
tasks.optimization_target: Keep one-to-one links between each required step and an exact live tool, including destructive-write follow-up steps.

tasks.failure_mode: Authentication/status checks repeat while the publish step is absent in one trial; the five-step chain is not kept intact.
tasks.optimization_target: Represent authentication as a precondition with a bounded retry budget, then retain publish/like/detail milestones as non-optional.

tasks.failure_mode: The fan-out notification task loses the calendar lookup and several recipient sends after capability planning compresses the chain.
tasks.optimization_target: Expand cardinality-sensitive steps explicitly (one send per recipient) and validate completion against the planned recipient set.

tasks.failure_mode: The calendar/contact/create dependency remains nominally present but loses required evidence and parameter correctness after aggressive call reduction.
tasks.optimization_target: Carry required identifiers and write parameters from the plan into the next tool input, and block only redundant retries rather than required corrections.

tasks.title: Add SQL Migration Preflight Checks and Rollback Safety
tasks.failure_mode: Writer+Director cuts the tool trace while the oracle loses idempotency/constraint evidence.
tasks.optimization_target: Make every required deliverable and verification clause a hard plan milestone before execution.

tasks.title: Inspect Two Local Images And Save Short Answers
tasks.failure_mode: The Writer plan is much shorter and does not reliably preserve the image-specific inspection and output obligations.
tasks.optimization_target: Keep multimodal inputs and per-image output cardinality explicit in the Actor handoff without adding speculative calls.

tasks.title: Metric definition audit against dashboard formulas
tasks.failure_mode: Outcome drops despite nearly unchanged call count, indicating semantic plan/content loss rather than removable retries.
tasks.optimization_target: Preserve equivalence rules, required fields and final validation text in the Writer final_scripts contract.

tasks.title: Local API Cursor Retry Ledger
tasks.failure_mode: A large reduction in calls is accompanied by missed dataset/ledger evidence in one trial; the retry loop is not reliably retained.
tasks.optimization_target: Encode pagination, 429/503/410 recovery and checkpoint verification as bounded state transitions, not optional prose.

tasks.title: Multi-Source Production Incident Analysis
tasks.failure_mode: The required incident report is missed in both Writer+Director repeats even though the rest of the artifact set is produced.
tasks.optimization_target: Preserve cross-file evidence-to-artifact links and add a final oracle-oriented completeness check before stopping.
